constraints.OOM_behavior: Native diagnostic failure must be retained; inherited supervisor cleans only its own verified session, returns STOPPED_NO_AUTO_RETRY, and never kills another GPU process. No automatic rerun or GPU switch.
constraints.launch_requirement: Lead binds this exact wrapper and review, the unchanged v3 registration, gpu_admission and runtime_environment in the admission. Existing parent/child preflight checks obtain fresh available memory.

details: Explicit sharing policy required in admission and both independent reviews.
Parent and child use the same existing preflight. nvidia-smi reads the registered UUID and memory.free with the existing 10-second timeout.
The former no-process/128-MiB-used predicate is replaced by UUID equality and free-memory >=61440 MiB. No foreign process is signalled.
All mathematical, precision, scene/rank, read/RSS/output/time, lock, namespace, and own-process cleanup code remains identical.

inherits.original_nine_cpu_fixtures: Retained: all read/RSS/wall/output supervision and owned-session cleanup AST unchanged
inherits.v2_determinism: Exact CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 before torch import retained

memory_evidence_and_limits.mathematical_interpretation: Separate BF16 objective backward passes with FP32 CPU aggregation; not an actual ZeRO-2 update.
runtime_CUDA_lifecycle: Frozen encoder and old action policy coexist on GPU during 32-scene condition reconstruction.
Encoder is deleted and CUDA cache is emptied before deepcopy(old) creates the trainable policy. Old and trainable policy coexist for replay/backward.
Microbatch size remains 4, original CFM50 chunking/checkpointing remain unchanged. Two accumulated FP32 gradient vectors live on CPU; no optimizer states or optimizer updates are created.
sharing_risks: memory.free is an admission snapshot, not an exclusive reservation or a 60-GiB per-process allocation cap.
Other workloads can grow after preflight; the diagnostic can OOM or exceed its original wall limit under contention.
This review makes no throughput guarantee and cannot guarantee other workloads retain the same latency or future free memory.
On failure, preserve evidence and stop this attempt without signalling other workloads or automatically retrying.
memory_evidence_and_limits.threshold_basis: 60 GiB is an explicitly authorized operational spare-capacity threshold, not a measured successful peak or a proof that the complete diagnostic fits.
memory_evidence_and_limits.v1_peak_CUDA_memory: Not established: the failed v1 supervisor receipt reports CPU RSS, not GPU memory, and the diagnostic returns peak_cuda fields only on successful completion.

single_recommendation: Use the existing v3 host/GPU1 namespace exactly once with explicitly approved shared spare-capacity admission: matching UUID and at least 61440 MiB (60 GiB) free at both parent and child preflight. Preserve every existing process; no search for another GPU, new output version, preemption, automatic retry or changed math is needed.

target_snapshot.note: This single snapshot happened to show no compute process. Approval also permits nonzero existing processes when the exact free-memory and identity checks pass. No continuing idle claim is made.
